name: UnmergeCells
label: Unmerge Cells (HTTP)
description: Unmerges a previously merged range of Excel cells in a workbook stored in OneDrive or SharePoint.

fields.name: TenantId
fields.label: Tenant ID
fields.description: The Azure AD tenant identifier (e.g., 'contoso.onmicrosoft.com' or a GUID). Used to authenticate with Microsoft 365.

fields.name: ClientId
fields.label: Client ID
fields.description: The Application (Client) ID of the Azure AD app registered to access Microsoft Graph.

fields.name: ClientSecret
fields.label: Client Secret
fields.description: The client secret of the Azure AD application. Ensure it has the necessary permissions (e.g., Files.ReadWrite.All).

fields.name: DriveId
fields.label: Drive ID
fields.description: The unique ID of the OneDrive or SharePoint document library drive where the file is stored.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.label: File Path
fields.description: The relative path to the Excel file in the drive (e.g., 'Reports/Financials.xlsx').

fields.name: WorksheetName
fields.label: Worksheet Name
fields.description: The name of the worksheet containing the merged cells to unmerge (e.g., 'Summary').

fields.name: RangeAddress
fields.label: Range Address
fields.description: The address of the merged cell range to unmerge, in A1 notation (e.g., 'A1:D1'). Must exactly match a currently merged range.
